# Test fixtures

## `fpocket_out/`

A hand-written sample of an fpocket output directory, in fpocket's own output format.

**It was not produced by running fpocket.** It exists so that
`pocketscribe.pockets.parse_fpocket_output` can be unit tested on a machine without
fpocket installed, which is the normal case in CI. It is a *format* sample for testing
a parser, and the numbers in it are illustrative rather than results — nothing in the
repository presents them as fpocket output for any real structure.

If you change the fpocket parser, check it against real fpocket output as well. A
format sample can only tell you that the parser reads what it expects to read.

The layout mirrors what fpocket writes:

```
fpocket_out/
  example_info.txt          per-pocket descriptors
  pockets/
    pocket1_atm.pdb         atoms lining pocket 1
    pocket2_atm.pdb         atoms lining pocket 2
    pocket3_atm.pdb         atoms lining pocket 3
```

## Bundled example structures

The synthetic structures the tests analyse live in
`pocketscribe/data/example_structures/` rather than here, because
`pocketscribe demo` needs them after a `pip install` and they therefore have to ship as
package data. They are generated by `scripts/make_example_structures.py` — see the
docstring there for why they are synthetic.
